name: Google authentication through Clerk
manualSteps: Enable Google under Clerk SSO connections for all users.
For production, register Clerk's exact redirect URI in a Google OAuth client and keep the client secret in Clerk.
Exercise Google sign-in, existing-account linking, protected API access, and sign-out.
